messages:
Sam (PM): Pushed a small UX change to the onboarding strip — called the 'sparkline' — that surfaces a tiny progress indicator + 3 sample projects. Can folks skim and flag any issues? :eyes: Ida (PM/Design): Saw it — +1 on the concept, but copy feels dense. 'Pick a sample project to get started' is fine, maybe shorten to 'Start with a sample project'. CTA text should be one verb. Ravi (Eng): Looks lightweight, should be fine perf-wise. One catch: the strip is currently rendered client-side for first-run only; if we add dynamic counts it will add a render pass. Prefer static for now. Maya (DevEx): Suggest showing only 2 samples on mobile, 3 on desktop. Right now cards overflow on small widths and push the primary CTA off-screen. Ida (PM/Design): Accessibility nit: the sparkline color (teal 300) vs white on the light bg doesn't meet 4.5:1 for small text. Need higher contrast for the progress percentage. Also the progress is purely visual — screen readers see nothing. Jo (Accessibility): Agreed. We should include an aria-label on the progress element, e.g. ```
...
``` and ensure keyboard focus lands on the first card. Ravi (Eng): Easy to add the role/aria attribute. Keyboard focus change: are we making the strip a composite widget? That could be heavier. Another option: focus trap only when user opens the full onboarding modal. Ida (PM/Design): We want lightweight discoverability without modal friction. Proposal: keep strip as plain list of cards with tab order, but add a skip link to jump to the main console. That avoids complex widget behavior. Sam (PM): Metric ask — goal is to increase sample project selection by 15% from the current baseline. If we change copy + reduce visual noise, we should A/B test. Can product ops set up an experiment? Maya (DevEx): Yep, can wire an event: `onboard_strip.sample_selected` with sample_id. Quick note: include variant id and screen size in payload. Ida (PM/Design): Copy suggestions: primary CTA -> 'Try sample', secondary -> 'Skip for now'. Replace paragraph with one liner and microcopy under each card (25 chars). Jo (Accessibility): Also include visible focus state for each card (2px solid #0366d6 or similar). And make the card role=`button` if we handle enter/space to open. Ravi (Eng): I'll prototype with simple clickable divs + role=button. If QA ok, we won't need a11y refactor. Sam (PM): UX question: do we show the sparkline on repeat visits? thinking: show only until they pick or skip once. Otherwise it clutters dashboard. Ida (PM/Design): Agree. One impression only or until action. Consider adding a small 'Dismiss' (x) — but make it accessible (aria-label="dismiss onboarding strip"). Maya (DevEx): Mobile layout mock attached: https://files.redwood/example/sparkline-mobile.png — current overflow is visible there. Ravi (Eng): Quick code snippet for aria role I will use: ```
...
``` keeps SRs informed when it appears. Sam (PM): Great. Next steps: Ida to update mocks with copy + high-contrast palette; Ravi to prototype accessible attributes; Maya to add analytics event; Jo to sign off on a11y checklist. I'll schedule a 20m sync if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
